siteSafety.check: Website safety check (/safe, basic tier: passive signals only, no blocklist)
siteSafety.data: Phishing.Database active-link list (MIT), 300 random listed URLs (one per site); 46 legitimate sites chosen by us

phishingListed.note: Retracted. The first phishing figures came from a public list of "active" phishing links, but when we looked at the pages that answered, nearly all were already taken down (Cloudflare "Suspected Phishing" warnings, 404 and "page not found" pages, parked or deleted sites). Those results do not measure how well the check finds live phishing, so they are withdrawn. The test is being rebuilt with fresher sources and a check that each page is really live.

siteSafety.note: Sites that could not be reached are left out of the rates. A dead phishing site is not a detection. The paid /safe-pro tier adds a Google Web Risk lookup, which this test does not cover.

caveats: Samples are small, so each rate comes with a 95% interval. A wide interval means the true rate could be well above or below the figure.
The legitimate-site set is mostly well-run sites with good security settings, so false-alarm rates here are probably lower than on the wider web.
These results come from running the check code on a desktop computer. The live service runs on Cloudflare Workers, which can differ slightly (for example, reading certificate details).
Honeypot, preflight and sanctions checks are not covered yet.
